investment_strategy: Barbell exposure to the AI cycle: anchor the portfolio in lower-volatility, cash‑rich platform leaders (MSFT, GOOGL) with durable earnings and strong analyst support, complemented by a measured allocation to high‑beta AI infrastructure (NVDA) benefiting from data center GPU demand. Macro backdrop (VIX ~17, 10Y ~3.8%) supports growth multiples, but regulatory and export-control headlines warrant position sizing discipline. Rebalance quarterly or on regime shifts (e.g., VIX > 25 or 10Y > 4.5%) to trim high‑vol names and preserve capital.
